points.description: States that an orthotropic material has 9 independent elastic constants (exactly nine).
States that the material properties at a point differ along three mutually orthogonal axes (three orthogonal directions/planes of material symmetry).
points.partial_credit: Half only if properties are said to differ with direction but the three orthogonal axes are not stated.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both elements stated precisely: exactly 9 elastic constants, and properties at a point differing along 3 orthogonal axes. A wrong number of constants (e.g. 2, 5, 21) gives 0 for P1. Vague answers such as "properties vary with direction" without the three orthogonal axes earn at most half of P2; generic or unrelated statements earn nothing.
